title: Zoning text change for housing at 629 West 54th Street, Manhattan
summary: This application would amend zoning rules for the Special Hudson River Park District and Special Clinton District and establish a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing Area at 629 West 54th Street in Manhattan. It is one of three related actions that would allow a mixed-use development with about 506,000 square feet of residential and commercial space. The change also enables transfer of floor area to support improvements in Hudson River Park.
